sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished high-quality unique CLEAN BACKGROUND PLATE for portrait4:5 jigsaw puzzle illustration "A succulent terrace with warm terracotta pots". Premium cozy travel-game storybook digital painting matching approved Art Direction V2 gameplay art: tactile subtly brushed surfaces, fine hand-painted detail, believable dimensional objects, gentle upper-left sunlight, rich color separation and small discoveries. NOT flat vector, NOT photorealistic, NOT generic procedural art. Succulents and sage-green rosettes fill most of the frame at close range. Terracotta pots are small warm accents, not dominant; pale cool green wall behind. Grounded terrace, detailed rosette forms, no distant city monuments. Include pots and real stems, no insects yet. Viewpoint: eye-level intimate view. The picture must fill the entire portrait4:5 canvas, ideal1280x1600; no borders, text, UI, grid, title, logo, watermark or transparent holes. This is a complete naturally composed environment with real stable anchors for five small moving details later added as separate alpha layers. Do not add floating decorative particles or overlay patterns. Preserve coherent scale and perspective. No famous destination landmark. Keep the requested main color visible throughout the scene, not only a tiny accent.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A production RGBA transparent sprite atlas of five unique painted details belonging to the scene "A succulent terrace with warm terracotta pots". Match a premium cozy illustrated puzzle: rich dimensional storybook digital painting, subtle brushed pigment, believable natural forms, fine detail, soft upper-left sun, coherent warm light and tactile materials. No flat vector, no photos, no generic geometric particles. EXACTLY five isolated objects, strict3 columns by2 rows, landscape3:2 canvas. Leave the sixth bottom-right cell perfectly empty transparent. TRUE alpha transparency, no matte, no background, no grid or cell borders, no frame, no shadow rectangle, no labels or text. Place each entire object inside the central50% of its own cell, leaving wide25% gutters on every side. FULL complete loops, stems, wings, wisps and thin strands must fit safely inside each cell; none may touch canvas or cell edges. Top row left to right: a trailing string-of-pearls succulent strand, green round leaves on one curved stem; an upright slim pink echeveria flowering stalk with a tapered lower stem; a small jade-plant branch with plump oval sage-green leaves, lower stem. Bottom row left to right: a delicate aloe flower spire with pale coral bells, thin lower stalk; one tiny ladybird beetle, warm orange-red shell, six delicate legs, viewed obliquely from above; EMPTY. Preserve detailed painted alpha edges and translucent material where specified. Do not include containers, scenery or extra items. All five details are real meaningful parts of this specific scene, sharing its scale and light.

authoring.visualReviewNotes: Reviewed final master and original details against the approved painted game style. The rosette flower grows from the existing succulent; pearl strand, jade sprig and aloe stalk join plants; ladybird rests on a fleshy leaf. Actual palette sample is [260, 680, 580, 1100] in1280x1600 source space; no landmark observed. Implementation art review only, not PM approval.
